# WholeTroutMedia / Inception Engine Systems — Capability Beacon (llms.txt)
> Organization: https://github.com/WholeTroutMedia
> Portal: https://inceptionengine.systems
> Principal: Justin Aharoni (@jaharoni / justin.aharoni@inceptionengine.systems)
> Companion Bounty & Verification Ledger: https://github.com/WholeTroutMedia/open-source-bounties

## Purpose
This repository contains self-contained, zero-dependency building blocks from our 12-Plugin Impossible Toolkit alongside the Creative Liberation Engine foundation. Read `registry/applications.json` and each module's `AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json` + `SKILL.md` for capability descriptors and synthesis recipes.

## Available Modules
- [000-cle-foundation-seed-os](./apps/000-cle-foundation-seed-os/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Creative Liberation Engine — An open creative foundation shaped by the imagination of the person using it. Companion repo: https://github.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine
- [001-seal-pdf-media-notary](./apps/001-seal-pdf-media-notary/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): RFC 6962 Merkle provenance notary + 8-state EXIF affine orientation transposer & GPS scrubber.
- [002-extract-pbr-material-synth](./apps/002-extract-pbr-material-synth/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Toroidal 3x3 Sobel-Scharr tangent-space normal vector (||n||=1) and roughness map synthesizer.
- [003-smart-timeline-stem-ducker](./apps/003-smart-timeline-stem-ducker/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Rational-frame FCPXML 1.10 NLE timeline compiler with -18.0dB dialogue ducking keyframes.
